scope: Welcome/installation page and confirmed installed startup only. Existing application bundle is byte-identical to the previous release.

browserTests.scope: Compiled PWA and native desktop Chromium, real service worker/IndexedDB/localStorage. Android/iPhone user-agent and standalone property are explicitly simulated. Library/queue migration uses declared metadata fixtures in isolated browser storage. No OS install, physical phone, car, provider audio or public deployment claim.

publicInstalled.scope: Installed browser app lifecycle in a disposable desktop profile, controlled by CDP; not the native install dialog or a physical mobile device.

publicBrowser.scope: Public landing and installation-guide canary, fresh Chromium context at390×844. No opening the player, catalogue requests, audio, native installation or library writes.

limitations: Mobile user-agent and navigator.standalone tests are desktop simulations, not physical Android/iPhone verification.
CDP installation uses a disposable desktop profile and does not verify the native confirmation dialog.
Ordinary browser visits cannot infer an installation that the browser does not expose.
No native Android Auto or Apple CarPlay integration was added.
